title: GOLDEN 40S - The Red Route
creativeIntent: Decisive 2D film test with readable first frames, continuous cause-and-effect, visible dialogue portraits, a clear handoff, launch, and calm space resolution. No fake 3D and no intentionally empty shot openings.

testPlan.purpose: Separate Preview quality from authoring/story quality.
coreChecks: Every beat has meaningful visible content on its first frame
2D screen geography reads without explanatory prose
attacker -> projectile -> target -> impact -> destroy causality reads
VFX does not erase the protected subject
two named dialogue portraits are simultaneously visible and remain distinct
ground-to-ship handoff is visible before motion begins
launch creates scale change using 2D position/scale only
ending resolves in calm visible formation rather than beginning blank
testPlan.truthRule: Browser motion or VFX timing beyond serialized fields is Preview inference. Unity remains authoritative for runtime materialization.

beats.storyClaim: The last evacuation bus crosses the red route with a ground escort.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: Escort and bus are already readable at cut-in, then continue in the same left-to-right screen direction.

camera.subject: bus
camera.purpose: Establish one simple screen geography before danger begins.

beats.evidence: At the first frame, the mecha is foreground-left and the bus is mid-right; neither begins off-screen.

beats.storyClaim: A ground bomb drops directly over the route while the bus remains visible below.

actions.subject: ground_bomb
actions.result: The bomb begins visibly high above the bus and descends toward the route.

camera.subject: ground_bomb
camera.purpose: Keep bomb and bus in one frame so the threat relationship is immediately readable.

beats.evidence: From the first frame, the bomb is clearly above the bus and both remain visible.

beats.storyClaim: The escort fires once and intercepts the falling threat before it reaches the bus.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: Mecha fires across the frame; projectile crosses to the bomb; impact flashes on target before target disappears.

actions.subject: ground_bomb
actions.result: The bomb deactivates after the visible impact.

camera.subject: mecha
camera.purpose: Do not decorate the action. Make cause and effect readable.

beats.evidence: Mecha, bomb and bus are simultaneously readable; an impact occurs on the bomb and the bomb disappears.

beats.storyClaim: A blast erupts behind the convoy, but the bus survives and the route remains open.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: Rear explosion blooms behind the escort while the bus remains readable and moving ahead.

camera.subject: bus
camera.purpose: Keep the surviving bus as the visual priority while the explosion supplies urgency behind it.

beats.evidence: The bus remains visible and intact while a large explosion appears behind the convoy.

beats.storyClaim: Two visible pilots make the decision that turns the chase into an evacuation handoff.

dialogue.speaker: green_pilot
dialogue.text: The road is open. Send the last ship.

camera.subject: green_pilot
camera.purpose: A short cut-based dialogue beat tests identity and pacing without forbidden locked-dialogue camera motion.

beats.evidence: Both pilot portraits are visible from the first frame while two short lines trade speaker/listener roles.

beats.storyClaim: The last bus reaches the evacuation craft and the ground story acquires a visible destination.

actions.subject: bus
actions.result: Bus and evacuation craft are visible immediately; the bus closes the final gap toward the ship.

camera.subject: evac_ship
camera.purpose: Make the destination explicit instead of cutting away before the handoff reads.

beats.evidence: The first frame already contains bus and evacuation craft in one readable handoff composition.

beats.storyClaim: The evacuation craft lifts from the surface while the ground escort is left behind.

actions.subject: evac_ship
actions.result: The visible evacuation craft rises upward through the frame while the small ground escort stays behind as scale reference.

camera.subject: evac_ship
camera.purpose: Shift the film from ground-scale urgency to a larger departure image using 2D scale and framing only.

beats.evidence: Ship is visible at cut-in near the surface, then rises while the escort remains small and stationary below.

beats.storyClaim: The evacuation craft joins its escort in open space and the film resolves into calm forward motion.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: Both friendly ships are visible at cut-in, then drift together in a quiet stable formation.

camera.subject: evac_ship
camera.purpose: End on a large quiet environment with two small surviving ships instead of another action beat.

beats.evidence: The first and final frames both contain two small friendly ships against open space, with calm forward motion rather than a blank opening.
